macroMarketFundamentals.implication: Bangladesh outbound demand is rising steadily across undergraduate, MBBS, and postgraduate tiers, led by families comparing long-term degree ROI against local private fees.
macroMarketFundamentals.sourceNote: OECD Education at a Glance baseline & 2025–2026 ICEF / industry outbound estimates

macroMarketFundamentals.figure: 12,700 students in UK (HESA 2024–25) · Graduate Route 18 mos from Jan 2027
macroMarketFundamentals.implication: Shorter 18-month post-study Graduate visas (applied on or after 1 Jan 2027) and stricter sponsor compliance require realistic upfront UK ROI checks.
macroMarketFundamentals.sourceNote: HESA via UUK & GOV.UK Immigration Rules

macroMarketFundamentals.figure: BDT ~30% depreciation over <3 yrs · 49% population under age 24
macroMarketFundamentals.implication: Because parents/guardians co-fund education in BDT, separating institutional tuition from living costs and checking official bank exchange rates prevents mid-degree funding shocks.
macroMarketFundamentals.sourceNote: IMF / Bangladesh macro context; EduExpress parent consultation records

macroMarketFundamentals.figure: 46% student AI tool usage in 2026 college search (up from 26% in 2025)
macroMarketFundamentals.implication: Students and counselors increasingly cross-check fees and visas via AI assistants — making dated, open-license, source-cited datasets essential.

macroMarketFundamentals.figure: ~429 agencies nationally (61% based in Dhaka; median 11–50 staff)
macroMarketFundamentals.implication: Heavy Dhaka agency density without mandatory fee standardization makes written ClearCost schedules and B2B non-poaching MOUs critical differentiators.

studentFileVsChinaPayment.studentFileCountries: Required for countries needing advance tuition or blocked-account remittance (Malaysia, UK, Finland, Hungary self-funded, Germany, Australia, USA). Governed by Bangladesh Bank GFET via an Authorized Dealer (AD) bank branch.
studentFileVsChinaPayment.chinaAdvantage: Not required for full CSC / Type A scholarships (zero tuition remittance) and most self-funded/provincial-waiver Chinese tracks where fees are settled on campus upon arrival during registration week.

studentFileVsChinaPayment.studentFileCountries: Official Offer Letter, itemized institutional fee estimate, attested academic transcripts, IELTS/test score, valid passport/visa, TM form, and sponsor financial/TIN files locked to one AD bank branch (1 academic year limit per release).
studentFileVsChinaPayment.chinaAdvantage: Standard passport foreign-currency endorsement (USD/CNY) + dual-currency bank card for personal transition funds, transitioning to Alipay/WeChat Pay on campus.

studentFileVsChinaPayment.studentFileCountries: Typical bank Student File opening fee of BDT 5,000–6,000 + VAT, annual renewal fee, SWIFT transfer fees, and multi-day bank branch compliance review before visa deadlines.
studentFileVsChinaPayment.chinaAdvantage: Zero AD Student File opening fee and zero cross-border wire delay before departure on eligible routes — a major relief for Bangladeshi guardians.
